segments.text: എവിടുന്നാണ് കമാലി

segments.en: Now just sitting bored. Who all are there? Here, father, mother, and younger sister.

segments.text: അനിയത്തി അത്രയേ ഉള്ളൂ കേട്ടില്ല അച്ഛനമ്മ അനിയൻ അനിയത്തി അല്ലല്ലല്ല
segments.en: Younger sister, that's all. Didn't hear? Father, mother, younger brother, younger sister, no no no.

segments.en: No work? What, no work, is that why you reached here? Which place?

segments.en: Okay, how is it? Did the brothers come and ask something? The brothers have no work, right, that's why they come and ask?

segments.en: By saying experienced directly, I got one, like that directly...

segments.en: A small deficiency. What deficiency, how to say, a...
